tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa bzhugs so// gtor ma byin rlabs yi dam gang byas ltar dran par byas la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' rlung dkyil rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i steng du/ zhing chen sa gzhir keng rus kyi ri rab kyi steng du thod mkhar gru bzhi pa'i nang du/ pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dpal dur khrod kyis bdag po yab yum la/ 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzāḥ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ces pas dam la bzhag oṃ gṛ ha ra dza gṛ ha ra dza/ ku ma ku ma khuṃ thi swā hā/ shrī sh+ma sha na a ti pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra yi dam ba liṃ bhuñja kha kha/ khā hi/ khā hi/ sarba sid+dhaṃ me pra yats+tshan+tu swā hā/ tshar gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ shrī sh+ma sha na a ti pa ta ye sa pa ri wa' ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ hūm̐ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /rab dkar keng rus brjid pa'i sku/ /dam tshig can la brtser dgongs pa'i/ /nor gyis bdag po yab yum bstod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob la/ /chos kyi bar chad nyer zhi zhing / mthun rkyen ma lus 'bad med du/ /'byung ba'i bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa 'di'ang bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo bsdus pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
